abstract: Apple plants are highly susceptible to various diseases that can significantly reduce crop quality and yield. Traditional manual inspection is time-consuming, inconsistent, and requires expert knowledge, making automated disease detection essential for modern agriculture. This project presents an intelligent Apple Fruit Disease Prediction and Recommendation System using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm. abstract: "Child gait analysis plays a vital role in understanding the motor development, mobility patterns, and potential walking disorders in toddlers. To address this, the Child Gait Prediction system has been developed as a Python Streamlit application that leverages machine learning techniques to predict the type of gait in toddlers based on measurable parameters such as heel pressure, toe pressure, tilt angle, step duration, stride length, and walking speed. exact_title: Customer churn prediction system: a machine learning approach
abstract: The customer churn prediction (CCP) is one of the challenging problems in the telecom industry. With the advancement in the field of machine learning and artificial intelligence, the possibilities to predict customer churn has increased significantly. Our proposed methodology, consists of six phases. In the first two phases, data pre-processing and feature analysis is performed. In the third phase, feature selection is taken into consideration using gravitational search algorithm. Next, the data has been split into two parts train and test set in the ratio of 80% and 20% respectively. In the prediction process, most popular predictive models have been applied, namely, logistic regression, naive bayes, support vector machine, random forest, decision trees, etc. on train set as well as boosting and ensemble techniques are applied to see the effect on accuracy of models. In addition, K-fold cross validation has been used over train set for hyper parameter tuning and to prevent over fitting of models. Finally, the obtained results on test set have been evaluated using confusion matrix and AUC curve.

exact_title: DEA-RNN: A Combined Deep Learning Method for Cyberbullying Detection on Twitter
abstract: Cyberbullying is an important issue for our society and has a major negative effect on the victims that can be highly damaging due to the frequency and high propagation provided by Information Technologies. Therefore, the early detection of cyberbullying in social networks becomes crucial to mitigate the impact on the victims. In this article, we aim to explore different approaches that take into account the time in the detection of cyberbullying in social networks. We follow a supervised learning method with two different specific early detection models, named threshold and dual. The former follows a more simple approach, while the latter requires two machine learning models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attempt to investigate the early detection of cyberbullying. We propose two groups of features and two early detection methods, specifically designed for this problem. We conduct an extensive evaluation using a real world dataset, following a time-aware evaluation that penalizes late detections. Our results show how we can improve baseline detection models. exact_title: DEEP LEARNING BASED PARKINSON’S DISEASE DIAGNOSIS THROUGH RECURRENT NEURAL NETWORKS WITH INCEPTION NET MODELS
abstract: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks are a leading model for Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems because they are highly regarded in deep learning (DL) and have shown promising results in medical dataset processing. In addition to Parkinson's Disease (PD), which is commonly diagnosed with Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography (SPECT) scans, their value extends to the detection of neurological disorders. However, relying entirely on visual assessment of SPECT datasets during medical tests can lead to errors due to subjective considerations. To address this issue, we propose a CAD system that utilizes pre-trained LSTM models, the Deep Learning (DL) approach, and the Bilinear Pooling method. Inception Net models and a custom LSTM architecture are incorporated into this study. These pre-trained architectures were developed using the DL approach after being trained on the Inception Net. Three Bilinear LSTM models are produced by combining these architectures with bilinear pooling techniques. These models are applied to three distinct datasets of pre-processed SPECT imaging data from PD patients and Healthy Controls (HC).

exact_title: Fake News Detection using Deep learning
abstract: Recent political events have lead to an increase in the popularity and spread of fake news. As demonstrated by the widespread effects of the large onset of fake news, humans are inconsistent if not outright poor detectors of fake news. With this, efforts have been made to automate the process of fake news detection. The most popular of such attempts include “blacklists” of sources and authors that are unreliable. While these tools are useful, in order to create a more complete end to end solution, we need to account for more difficult cases where reliable sources and authors release fake news. As such, the goal of this project was to create a tool for detecting the language patterns that characterize fake and real news through the use of machine learning and natural language processing techniques. The results of this project demonstrate the ability for machine learning to be useful in this task. We have built a model that catches many intuitive indications of real and fake news as well as an application that aids in the visualization of the classification decision.

abstract: "The rapid growth of digital payments and online banking has increased the number of financial transactions performed every day, while also creating new opportunities for fraudulent activities. Traditional fraud detection systems often analyze transactions individually using predefined rules or conventional machine learning techniques. However, financial fraud is frequently connected to relationships between multiple accounts, devices, locations, and transactions, making it difficult to identify suspicious behavior by examining a single transaction alone. The proposed Early Detection of Financial Fraudulent Transactions Using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) aims to address this challenge by analyzing the relationships and behavioral patterns within financial transaction networks. The system is developed using Python, machine learning, and Graph Neural Network techniques. Financial entities such as customers, bank accounts, payment methods, devices, and transactions can be represented as nodes and relationships between them as edges. This graph-based representation enables the system to study not only individual transaction characteristics but also the connections between different entities.

abstract: "Human speech communicates not only words but also emotions through variations in tone, pitch, intensity, rhythm, and speaking style. Conventional speech recognition systems mainly focus on converting speech into text and often overlook the emotional state of the speaker. The proposed Multilingual Speech Emotion Recognition System Using Deep Learning aims to identify emotions from spoken audio across multiple languages, enabling more intelligent and human-aware voice interaction. The system accepts speech as input and extracts important acoustic features such as pitch, frequency, energy, and spectral characteristics. Deep learning techniques are then used to learn the relationship between these speech patterns and emotional states such as happiness, sadness, anger, fear, and neutrality. The model is designed to work across multiple languages, making it suitable for multilingual environments where pronunciation, vocabulary, and speaking styles may differ. The major uniqueness of the proposed system is its focus on how a person speaks rather than only what the person says. The system can identify emotional characteristics even when the language changes.

abstract: " The system is developed using Python, machine learning algorithms, and anomaly detection techniques to analyze network traffic and identify suspicious behavior. Relevant network features such as connection patterns, traffic volume, protocol information, duration, and packet-related characteristics are processed and provided to the learning models. This provides an additional layer of protection against unusual or previously unseen activities that may not match existing attack signatures. The system can also assign a risk level to detected network activities, allowing security administrators to identify potentially serious events more quickly.

Finding specific information from lengthy academic documents can be time-consuming, while conventional keyword-based search systems often fail to understand the actual meaning or context of a user's question. The proposed Retrieval-Augmented AI System for Intelligent Question Answering from Academic Documents aims to provide an intelligent solution that allows users to ask questions in natural language and receive answers based specifically on the information available in their academic documents. The proposed system is implemented using Python, Natural Language Processing, text embeddings, vector database technology, and Large Language Models (LLMs). Uploaded documents are first processed, cleaned, and divided into meaningful text segments. These segments are converted into numerical vector representations using embedding techniques and stored in a vector database. When a user asks a question, the system searches the stored document representations and retrieves the most semantically relevant content before generating the final answer.

abstract: "Road infrastructure maintenance is critical for ensuring public safety, reducing vehicle wear, and optimizing municipal budgets. Traditional road inspection methods rely on manual surveys or dedicated scanning vehicles, which are slow, labor-intensive, and expensive. To address these challenges, this study proposes an AI-based road damage detection and severity classification system utilizing the YOLO (You Only Look Once) framework combined with deep learning architectures. The system processes real-time road images or video feeds captured by standard vehicle-mounted cameras to identify various damage types, including longitudinal cracks, transverse cracks, alligator cracking, and potholes. By leveraging the real-time processing capabilities of YOLO, the proposed model detects anomalies and extracts critical bounding boxes representing distress locations. The detected damages are subsequently analyzed by a classification network that assesses their severity levels (e.g., low, medium, high) based on distress size, depth, and structural impact. The model is trained and validated on a comprehensive dataset of road damage images, achieving high precision and rapid inference rates.

exact_title: REAL-TIME DRIVER DROWSINESS DETECTION USING FACIAL LANDMARK ANALYSIS AND DEEP LEARNING
abstract: "Driver drowsiness is one of the leading causes of traffic accidents worldwide, resulting in significant loss of life and property damage. Developing an automated system that monitors driver attentiveness in real-time is essential to mitigate these risks and enhance road safety. This study presents a non-invasive, real-time driver drowsiness detection system that utilizes facial landmark analysis combined with deep learning techniques. The system uses a standard camera positioned on the vehicle dashboard to capture the driver's facial features under varying lighting conditions. Facial landmark analysis is employed to locate key facial regions, specifically the eyes, mouth, and head pose. Key metrics such as the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) and Mouth Aspect Ratio (MAR) are calculated to track eye closure duration and yawning frequency. A deep learning model, specifically a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, is then used to analyze temporal patterns in these metrics to distinguish between normal driving behaviors and signs of fatigue or distraction. The model is trained on a diverse dataset of facial expressions and simulated drowsiness scenarios, achieving robust generalization across different individuals.

exact_title: INTELLIGENT WASTE SEGREGATION AND CLASSIFICATION USING COMPUTER VISION AND DEEP LEARNING
abstract: " To enhance segregation accuracy, the system incorporates transfer learning using pre-trained architectures, enabling robust feature extraction even with limited training samples. The model is trained on a comprehensive dataset of common household and industrial waste items, achieving high accuracy in classification and localization. The output of the deep learning model is integrated with robotic actuators or pneumatic sorters to physically separate the classified items in real-time. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system provides high sorting throughput and classification accuracy compared to manual processes. Implementing this automated system in recycling centers can significantly increase recycling efficiency, reduce landfill dependency, and promote circular economy practices. "

exact_title: AI-BASED TRAFFIC VIOLATION DETECTION AND AUTOMATED LICENSE PLATE RECOGNITION SYSTEM
abstract: "As urban vehicle density continues to grow, enforcing traffic rules and maintaining road order have become increasingly challenging for law enforcement agencies. Traditional manual monitoring is insufficient for continuous surveillance and prone to human error. To address this, this study proposes an AI-based traffic violation detection and automated license plate recognition (ALPR) system. The system integrates advanced computer vision and deep learning algorithms to automatically monitor traffic cameras and detect common traffic infractions, such as red-light violations, speeding, illegal lane changes, and wrong-way driving. Object detection and tracking models, such as YOLO and DeepSORT, are utilized to identify vehicles, monitor their trajectories, and detect anomalous driving behaviors in real-time. Upon detecting a violation, the system automatically isolates the vehicle's region of interest and applies a dedicated deep learning-based ALPR model to extract the license plate characters under diverse environmental conditions, including poor lighting and motion blur. The system is validated on traffic video datasets, demonstrating high accuracy in both violation detection and license plate transcription.

exact_title: PAVEMENT CRACK DETECTION AND SEVERITY ASSESSMENT USING DEEP LEARNING
abstract: "Regular assessment of pavement condition is vital for preserving road network integrity and ensuring commuter safety. Cracking is one of the earliest signs of pavement deterioration, and if left untreated, it can lead to severe structural failures like potholes. Traditional manual distress surveys are subjective, hazardous, and logistically challenging. This study proposes an automated pavement crack detection and severity assessment system based on deep learning. The system utilizes high-resolution pavement images collected by inspection vehicles or drones. A semantic segmentation network, such as U-Net or a modified DeepLabv3+, is developed to perform pixel-level segmentation, separating crack patterns from complex road background textures, shadows, and oil stains. Following crack localization, a severity assessment algorithm calculates the geometric properties of the cracks, such as width, length, and orientation, to classify the distress severity into low, medium, or high categories. The deep learning models are trained on large-scale annotated crack datasets, demonstrating exceptional performance in segmenting fine cracks and handling noisy backgrounds.

exact_title: REAL-TIME SIGN LANGUAGE RECOGNITION AND SPEECH CONVERSION USING DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: "Sign language is the primary medium of communication for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community, yet a significant communication gap exists between signers and the general public who do not understand sign language. To bridge this gap, this study presents a real-time sign language recognition and speech conversion system powered by deep neural networks. The system captures video sequences of sign language gestures using a standard camera. Deep learning architectures, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for spatial feature extraction and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) or Transformers for temporal sequence modeling, are used to interpret both static hand shapes and dynamic gestures. Landmark extraction models like MediaPipe are integrated to track hand gestures, facial expressions, and body poses in real-time. The recognized gestures are mapped to corresponding words or sentences in natural language, which are then converted into clear, synthesized speech using a text-to-speech (TTS) engine. The system is trained on a comprehensive vocabulary of sign language gestures, achieving high recognition accuracy and low latency.

exact_title: AI-BASED FIRE AND SMOKE DETECTION USING REAL-TIME VIDEO SURVEILLANCE
abstract: "Fire and smoke outbreaks pose catastrophic risks to human life, property, and environmental safety, necessitating prompt and reliable automated monitoring systems. Conventional sensor-based fire alarms often suffer from delayed response times due to physical distance from fire sources and are incapable of providing spatial context or early smoke visual cues. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes an advanced AI-based fire and smoke detection framework utilizing real-time video surveillance footage. The system incorporates deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and real-time object detection models to capture spatio-temporal features, including flame color distributions, flicker motion patterns, and expanding smoke plume dynamics. These extracted visual features enable rapid detection of early-stage fires and faint smoke emissions directly from existing closed-circuit television (CCTV) infrastructure. The proposed model is trained on an extensive, benchmarked dataset of indoor and outdoor video streams containing diverse environmental lighting conditions, atmospheric haze, and potential visual distractors such as bright headlights or sunlight reflections.

exact_title: AI-BASED FRUIT QUALITY GRADING AND DEFECT DETECTION USING COMPUTER VISION
abstract: "Quality assessment and grading in the agricultural and food processing industries are critical for minimizing post-harvest losses, ensuring food safety, and meeting export quality standards. Manual inspection methods are labor-intensive, subjective, and prone to inconsistency due to human fatigue and visual limitations. To address these operational challenges, this research presents an intelligent computer vision system for automated fruit quality grading and defect detection. The proposed architecture employs deep learning models to process high-resolution images of harvested fruits, extracting fine-grained features such as surface color uniformity, shape irregularities, size metrics, and localized skin defects including bruises, rot, and pest damage. The deep learning model is trained on a comprehensive image repository featuring multiple fruit varieties across varying maturity stages and environmental lighting conditions. Transfer learning techniques combined with convolutional feature extractors enable the system to classify fruits into distinct quality grades (e.g., Premium, Standard, and Substandard) with high precision and throughput.

exact_title: AI-BASED DOCUMENT FORGERY DETECTION USING IMAGE PROCESSING AND DEEP LEARNING
abstract: " Trained on a dataset containing authentic and synthetically forged document samples across various formats, the deep learning model extracts spatial and frequency domain features to identify tampered regions with fine granularity. Comparative evaluation against baseline forensic algorithms confirms superior sensitivity and lower false-alarm rates in highlighting forged regions. The automated system generates detailed heatmaps indicating potential manipulation zones, thereby assisting financial institutions, legal entities, and verification agencies in validating document authenticity efficiently. This research provides a crucial defense mechanism against identity theft, financial fraud, and credential falsification."

exact_title: INTELLIGENT RESUME SCREENING AND JOB MATCHING USING NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
abstract: "Modern talent acquisition processes involve processing hundreds of candidate resumes for every job opening, creating significant administrative bottlenecks for human resource departments. Standard keyword-matching applicant tracking systems (ATS) often fail to capture contextual semantics, leading to qualified candidates being erroneously screened out due to minor phrasing discrepancies. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes an intelligent resume screening and candidate-job matching framework driven by Natural Language Processing (NLP) and transformer-based language models. The system parses unstructured resume documents (in PDF and DOCX formats), extracts structured entities such as technical skills, educational background, work experience, and domain expertise, and constructs semantic representations of candidate profiles. Using semantic similarity algorithms and fine-tuned BERT-based embeddings, the framework evaluates the alignment between candidate profiles and detailed job descriptions beyond surface-level keyword overlaps. The model scores and ranks candidates objectively, mitigating implicit human bias while highlighting key skill gaps and strengths.

exact_title: SKILL-GAP ANALYSIS AND PERSONALIZED CAREER RECOMMENDATION USING MACHINE LEARNING
abstract: "In the rapidly evolving global job market, emerging technological advancements continuously reshape required professional skill sets, creating substantial gaps between educational training and industry demands. Students and job seekers often struggle to identify specific skill deficiencies and navigate clear career advancement pathways. To address this challenge, this study introduces a machine learning-driven framework for automated skill-gap analysis and personalized career path recommendation. The system aggregates real-time job market postings and candidate profile data, applying natural language processing and feature extraction techniques to identify key competency requirements across diverse industry roles. The proposed model employs collaborative filtering and classification algorithms to compare an individual’s current skill matrix against benchmarked target role profiles, generating a quantified skill-gap score. Based on this assessment, the system delivers personalized learning roadmaps, suggesting targeted certification courses, technical skills, and project domains necessary to bridge identified gaps.

exact_title: Automated Product Defect Detection in Manufacturing Using Vision-Based Deep Learning
abstract: Manual quality inspection in manufacturing can be time-consuming and may produce inconsistent results, especially when defects are small or repetitive. This project proposes an automated visual inspection system that analyzes product images captured on a production line to detect and localize manufacturing defects. A deep-learning model identifies abnormalities such as scratches, cracks, dents, surface irregularities, missing components, and assembly defects. Instead of simply classifying products as defective or non-defective, the system generates a defect map and calculates a severity score based on defect size, location, and type. The inspection system maintains batch-level quality statistics and identifies recurring defect patterns that may indicate production-line problems. A dashboard provides defect counts, defect categories, rejected-product ratios, and production trends. The proposed approach can therefore function as both an automated inspection mechanism and an analytical tool for identifying quality-control issues in manufacturing.

exact_title: Intelligent Classroom Engagement Analysis Using Facial Expression and Activity Recognition
abstract: Traditional classroom evaluation generally relies on attendance and examination results, which do not provide continuous information about student engagement. This project proposes an AI-based classroom analytics system that estimates student engagement by combining facial expressions, head orientation, body activity, gaze direction, and classroom participation patterns. Video frames are processed to identify individual or group-level behavioral indicators while preserving privacy through anonymized student representations. A multimodal model combines these indicators to generate an engagement score instead of relying on facial expression alone. The system identifies patterns such as sustained attention, distraction, inactivity, and interaction during different portions of a lecture. An instructor dashboard visualizes engagement trends across the session and identifies time intervals where engagement significantly decreases. The system can then recommend interventions such as interactive questions, short activities, or topic transitions. The objective is not to judge students individually but to provide instructors with data-driven insights for improving teaching effectiveness.

exact_title: AI-Based Food Quality and Freshness Detection Using Computer Vision
abstract: Determining food freshness is commonly dependent on human inspection, which can be subjective and inconsistent. This project proposes an intelligent computer-vision system for estimating food quality by analyzing visible characteristics such as color variation, surface texture, structural changes, discoloration, and detected spoilage regions. Instead of producing only a fresh/rotten classification, the proposed system generates a progressive freshness score and identifies the visual regions contributing to quality degradation. A deep-learning model is combined with image-level feature analysis to estimate the stage of deterioration. The system can maintain a digital freshness history for individual batches and compare newly captured images with previous observations. A monitoring dashboard provides quality status, estimated deterioration stage, confidence level, and recommended inspection priority. The solution can be adapted for fruits, vegetables, or packaged food after domain-specific training. This approach aims to support objective preliminary quality screening and reduce dependence on inconsistent manual inspection.

exact_title: Personalized Healthcare Risk Assessment Using Machine Learning and Patient History Analysis
abstract: Healthcare risk assessment often considers individual medical parameters independently, while long-term patient history can contain valuable information about changing health patterns. This project proposes a personalized machine-learning framework that analyzes longitudinal patient records, lifestyle information, previous medical observations, medication patterns, and laboratory measurements to estimate future health risks. Rather than producing a single disease prediction, the system constructs a patient-specific risk profile and identifies the factors contributing most strongly to the estimated risk. A temporal analysis module compares current measurements with historical trends to identify abnormal changes. The platform provides interpretable risk scores, trend visualizations, and preventive recommendations for review by healthcare professionals. A confidence mechanism prevents the system from presenting uncertain predictions as definitive diagnoses. exact_title: AI-Based Handwritten Document Recognition and Information Extraction Using Deep Learning
abstract: Handwritten documents contain valuable information but are difficult to process automatically because handwriting styles, layouts, and document structures vary significantly. This project proposes an intelligent document-processing system that combines handwritten text recognition, document layout analysis, and semantic information extraction. The system first identifies relevant regions such as names, dates, addresses, identifiers, signatures, and handwritten content before converting the handwriting into machine-readable text. A deep-learning recognition model handles variations in writing style, while a semantic extraction module maps recognized content into predefined information fields. The system also assigns confidence scores to extracted information and highlights uncertain regions for human verification. Instead of treating the document as a plain image-to-text conversion task, the proposed solution creates a structured digital representation that can be exported to databases or enterprise applications. This can reduce manual data-entry effort while maintaining a human verification layer for uncertain recognition results.

exact_title: Smart Energy Consumption Forecasting and Optimization Using Machine Learning
abstract: Energy-management systems commonly forecast electricity consumption but do not always translate predictions into actionable optimization strategies. This project proposes an intelligent energy-management framework that learns consumption patterns from historical electricity usage, time of day, occupancy behavior, environmental conditions, and appliance-level information. A forecasting model predicts near-future energy demand, while an optimization module identifies high-consumption periods and proposes alternative operating schedules. Instead of simply minimizing energy usage, the proposed system attempts to balance energy consumption, user comfort, operational requirements, and peak-demand reduction. The platform continuously compares predicted and actual consumption and updates its recommendations based on observed deviations. A dashboard provides demand forecasts, consumption trends, peak-period alerts, and recommended load-shifting actions. The proposed system can support smart homes, educational institutions, or small commercial buildings and aims to transform energy forecasting into a practical decision-support and optimization platform.

exact_title: AI-Based Crowd Density Estimation and Anomaly Detection for Public Safety
abstract: Managing large crowds is challenging because dangerous situations can develop rapidly before security personnel recognize them. This project proposes an intelligent video-analytics system that combines crowd density estimation, movement-pattern analysis, and abnormal-event detection. Instead of relying only on people counting, the system analyzes changes in crowd distribution, movement direction, local congestion, sudden dispersal, unusual gathering behavior, and restricted-area movement. A spatiotemporal model generates a dynamic crowd-risk score for different regions of a monitored area. When an abnormal pattern exceeds a predefined confidence threshold, the system generates an alert and identifies the affected region on a monitoring dashboard. Historical event data can also be used to identify recurring congestion locations and time periods. The system is designed to assist security personnel in prioritizing areas requiring attention and enabling early intervention during public events, transportation hubs, and other high-density environments.

exact_title: Intelligent Railway Track Defect Detection Using Computer Vision and Deep Learning
abstract: Railway track inspection is traditionally dependent on periodic manual examination and specialized inspection equipment. This project proposes a computer-vision-based system that analyzes images or video captured from a moving inspection vehicle to identify visible railway defects. The system detects multiple defect categories including surface cracks, missing components, abnormal joints, track-surface deterioration, and foreign objects. A segmentation-based deep-learning model localizes the defective region rather than only assigning an image-level label. The detected defects are then assigned a severity score based on their visual characteristics and spatial dimensions. A geotagging module associates detected defects with their approximate track location, enabling maintenance teams to prioritize inspection. Historical inspection results can be compared to determine whether a defect is newly appearing or increasing in severity. The proposed solution therefore transforms visual inspection into a continuous monitoring and maintenance-prioritization system.

exact_title: AI-Based Weather Event Classification and Short-Term Prediction Using Deep Learning
abstract: Weather systems can change rapidly, making short-term prediction difficult using isolated weather observations. This project proposes a deep-learning framework that combines historical meteorological measurements, temporal weather patterns, and optional satellite or radar-derived features to identify and forecast short-term weather events. Instead of predicting only temperature or rainfall, the system classifies events such as heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, high-wind conditions, and abnormal weather transitions. A temporal model learns relationships between consecutive observations and generates event probabilities for future time intervals. The system also provides confidence scores and visualizes the environmental variables contributing to each prediction. When the predicted probability of a significant event exceeds a configurable threshold, an early-warning notification is generated. The proposed platform can support local planning and preparedness by converting continuous weather observations into understandable short-term event forecasts.

exact_title: AI-Based Accident Detection and Emergency Alert System Using Computer Vision
abstract: Road accidents often require immediate emergency intervention, but conventional accident reporting systems depend on witnesses or manual communication. This project proposes an intelligent computer-vision-based accident detection and emergency response system that continuously analyzes roadside or vehicle-camera video streams. Instead of detecting accidents solely from vehicle collisions, the proposed system combines vehicle trajectory changes, sudden deceleration, abnormal vehicle orientation, collision motion patterns, and post-collision immobility to distinguish genuine accidents from normal traffic events. A temporal deep-learning model analyzes consecutive frames and generates an accident confidence score. Once a high-confidence accident is identified, the system estimates the accident location and severity from visual evidence and automatically generates an emergency notification. The system can prioritize incidents based on severity and provide an event snapshot and confidence information to emergency personnel. A dashboard displays detected incidents, timestamps, locations, and response status.
